name: On-chain Forensics
description: Decision-first on-chain forensics over x402. Ask 'should I touch this token or wallet?' and get a graded answer: activity score 0-100, letter grade A-F, risk flags, and a reason, measured from chain reads with no LLM in the decision path. 500 tokens graded and published at onchainforensics.dev/t/. Paid per call in USDC, with a free developer key and a free embeddable badge.

services.name: x402 API gateway
services.description: Entry point. 'Should I touch this token or wallet?' returns the graded decision plus next calls.

services.name: verdict
services.description: Token or wallet activity verdict: grade, score, risk flags, roast.

services.name: settlesafe
services.description: Can this asset settle a payment? ERC-20 readability, canonical/counterfeit check, decimals.

services.name: memo
services.description: Composed due-diligence answer for one token or wallet: supply, activity, asset verification, minting, concentration.

services.name: sweep
services.description: Wallet portfolio sweep: real holdings, dormant dust, and what is worth ignoring.

services.name: free embeddable badge
services.description: SVG grade badge for any contract, no key, degrades to NOT GRADED instead of breaking a page.

services.name: MCP server
services.description: Six forensics tools for any MCP-capable agent: npx -y onchain-forensics-mcp
